```yaml
name: Test FATFS Support

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up GCC
      uses: actions/setup-gcc@v2
      with:
        gcc-version: '10'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y build-essential libssl-dev

    - name: Create FATFS image
      run: |
        dd if=/dev/zero of=fatfs.img bs=1M count=10
        mkfs.vfat fatfs.img

    - name: Mount FATFS image
      run: |
        mkdir -p /mnt/fatfs
        sudo mount -o loop fatfs.img /mnt/fatfs

    - name: Copy test file to FATFS image
      run: echo "Hello, FATFS!" | sudo tee /mnt/fatfs/testfile.txt

    - name: Unmount FATFS image
      run: sudo umount /mnt/fatfs

    - name: Build wolfSSH with FATFS support
      run: |
        ./autogen.sh
        ./configure --enable-fatsfpt
        make

    - name: Run wolfSFTP client to get test file
      run: |
        ./wolfssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa sftp://user@localhost:/testfile.txt /tmp/testfile.txt

    - name: Verify file exists and contents match
      run: |
        ls -l /tmp/testfile.txt
        diff <(echo "Hello, FATFS!") /tmp/testfile.txt
```
